allowed_claims: A user does not need to remain logged in to a connected social account for Buffer to post.
Buffer uses the access token to post on the user's behalf while login and permissions remain valid.
The Followers table shows current followers and the exact number gained or lost during the selected date range.
Insights reports the number of posts published during a period.
The Audience Growth view displays followers over time and net new followers gained.
Foster Coffee Company uses Buffer for social media publishing.
Foster captures new social content weekly and plans its direction from two weeks to a month in advance using Buffer.
Foster found that planning its Buffer publishing schedule two weeks ahead was its sweet spot.
Buffer lets users make last-minute schedule changes by clicking and dragging content.
Foster Coffee Company is a Michigan coffee business with two locations.
Foster Coffee Company achieved 30% year-on-year social media follower growth.
Kevin Indig saves 2 to 3 hours every week on content distribution using Buffer.
Buffer’s Free plan supports up to 3 connected channels.
A queue is included on Buffer’s Free, Essentials, and Team plans.
Buffer includes social post idea templates on its Free, Essentials, and Team plans.
Buffer includes an AI Assistant with unlimited credits for refining and repurposing content on its Free, Essentials, and Team plans.
Buffer includes a visual content calendar for viewing schedules across weeks or months on its Free, Essentials, and Team plans.
Buffer includes mobile reminder notifications for finishing posts natively on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube on its Free, Essentials, and Team plans.
Buffer includes comment insights that extract themes or ideas for new content on its Free, Essentials, and Team plans.
Buffer can turn a comment exchange into a new post on its Free, Essentials, and Team plans.
Buffer Insights provides follower growth, engagement, impressions, and post-performance data with 30-day history on Free and unlimited history on Essentials and Team.
Buffer provides AI-powered plain-language observations about what is working, what is not, and what to try next on its Free, Essentials, and Team plans.
For Facebook pages, Buffer supports automatic publishing, basic analytics, advanced analytics, and community engagement, but not notification publishing.
For Instagram business accounts, Buffer supports automatic publishing, notification publishing, basic analytics, advanced analytics, and community engagement.
Buffer offers a free plan.
No credit card is required to get started with Buffer's free plan.
unresolved_objections: Scheduling software does not fix our real problem, which is that Facebook shows our posts to almost nobody unless we pay.

Is there any verifiable product claim about paid amplification or about distribution beyond a page's existing followers, or should this audience be told plainly that the product measures reach rather than increases it?
recommendation.override_risk: Generating outside the eligible slice risks writing to a structurally similar company whose actual need the product cannot support.

agent_executions.error_message: The strategy promises a next-step payoff without any assigned proof.

report.request: Write exactly one concise English marketing email for an independent local business owner who plans social posts. Introduce Buffer through one problem: planning several posts ahead while keeping room for a timely local update.
